name: Memory Allocator (malloc/free)
task:
Please complete the following memory allocator task. Implement from scratch over a byte array.

Represent a heap as a byte array with block headers storing size and a free/allocated flag.

Implement malloc(size) using first-fit, splitting a free block when it is larger than needed.

Implement free(ptr) that marks a block free and coalesces it with adjacent free blocks.

Allocate blocks of sizes [16, 8, 32, 24], free the 2nd and 3rd, then allocate 16 again. Report the number of free blocks and the total free bytes after each step.

最终回答必须包含: 最终空闲块数=___, 最终空闲字节=___, 第二次分配16的起始偏移=___.
